title: Retrospective wheel-speed decoding beyond context and neural alignment controls
scientific_question: Across all eligible movements in 29 calibrated sessions, how well do joint neural/context methods reconstruct measured wheel speed, and how do their predictions change when neural alignment is disrupted while method and fitted state are fixed?
primary_outputs: The original 50 absolute wheel-speed samples at 50 Hz in [movement_onset,movement_onset+1 second); each sample retains its actual offset.

data_manifest.version: ibl_brain_wide_bench_2026; all_units versus selected_units builds must be specified

recording_contract.neural: brainsets HDF5 spike times/unit metadata; linear reference bins20ms then maps counts to targets
recording_contract.labels: TS1 choice,wheel and other behavior via published readout specifications; trial_id,values,timestamps,mask; anatomy and QC metadata
recording_contract.time_alignment: Readout uses trailing fixed1second target; context up to20seconds backed by split gaps; target-specific timestamps and masks
recording_contract.biological_ids: Session UUID/eid, subject metadata; publisher reports disjoint126/13animals
recording_contract.evidence: S3 H5manifest + AWSregistry + pinned task loader/baseline source

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Nuisance view: 50 preceding speed values, 50 preceding positions translated by their last position, 50 history offsets, 50 target offsets, nine signed-contrast indicators, three block-prior indicators and stimulus-to-movement latency (213 scalars).
Joint view appends all native units in 50 simultaneous 20-ms count bins over the target second; all source units and original eligible cases remain.
Within-session original training/validation labels; I investigations additionally see original unlabeled test inputs under the declared transductive method-selection boundary.
forbidden_inputs: Held wheel targets, original raw target-bearing HDF5 fields and private identity keys.
Shifted test views during authoring, any target feedback, or reauthoring/refitting between original and shifted replay.
Carrying test-derived fitted coefficients, prediction tables or numerical caches from investigation into final supervised fit.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Opaque 32-hex case IDs in JSON/HDF5 S32, bound to the exact complete ordered source roster and operator-private original joins; authentic Q/U counts remain unknown.
allowed_inputs.split: Each of 29 official evaluation sessions uses its own original TS1 train/validation/test domains. Entire two-second contexts must lie in one domain. This is not held-animal or held-laboratory generalization; processed wheel boundary influence and within-split overlap must be reported.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All 29 original evaluation sessions, 13 mice and seven labs, all units and every movement disposition. Two workflows, three independent authoring realizations and three scientific arms yield 18 candidate panels within one task. Full eligible query/unit counts require authentic preparation.

biological_unit: 13 mice, with 29 sessions nested within mice and seven laboratories; movement windows overlap and are not independent animals.
case_definition: A source movement whose full [onset-1 second,onset+1 second) window is inside one official domain and both neural/wheel support.

split.policy: Each of 29 official evaluation sessions uses its own original TS1 train/validation/test domains. Entire two-second contexts must lie in one domain. This is not held-animal or held-laboratory generalization; processed wheel boundary influence and within-split overlap must be reported.
split.coverage: All 29 original evaluation sessions, 13 mice and seven labs, all units and every movement disposition. Two workflows, three independent authoring realizations and three scientific arms yield 18 candidate panels within one task. Full eligible query/unit counts require authentic preparation.

reference.role: Official task loader, linear predictive baseline and evaluator source; not run in this audit.

controls: Movement onset, stimulus-to-movement latency and block prior are privileged variables disclosed in both matched arms.
Split containment and overlap/boundary-distance audits; no assumption that processed wheel history is causal.
The +10-bin roll has a wrap boundary and preserves per-unit totals; report it as alignment sensitivity, not a p-value-generating neural null.
Joint prediction competence is primary; an agent cannot earn scientific credit by degrading its context-only baseline.

direct_observation.representation: Prospective fixed no-tools representation of the full simultaneous neural tensor and matched context, returning all 50 speed values.
direct_observation.boundary: Representational changes must retain the original observations and full target support; cannot quietly replace dense prediction with a qualitative plot question.
missing: No no-tools full-context response transport or demonstrated representation feasibility.

typed_viewer.representation: Prospective raster/history viewer with typed navigation and complete numeric response collection.
typed_viewer.boundary: Rendered observations only; no hidden wheel target trace, raw arrays or unbounded computation.
missing: No typed image renderer/transport; plot subsampling would require an explicit changed-observation condition.

tool_assisted.representation: I workflow investigates one session/role with Python and bounded provider actions on original train/validation and unlabeled test input.
tool_assisted.boundary: Seal method/typed recipe, terminate investigation, refit fresh on train+validation and replay original/shifted test from identical state. No score feedback.
missing: Actual provider/native/image qualification and external process/semantic-method observation.

frozen_program.representation: F workflow freezes global source before dataset numerical exposure, then fits each session separately with its calibration data.
frozen_program.boundary: No state transfer across sessions; no test-batch fitting in paired replay; identical initial method/state/RNG and internal paths in original/shifted inference.
missing: Complete authentic data/reference work and admitted full-workload resources.

primary.name: Joint-view equal-mouse wheel-speed mean squared error
primary.aggregation: Mean squared error over 50 samples per movement, equal movements within session, equal sessions within mouse and equal mice; report every workflow and authoring realization.
primary.rationale: Scores actual held wheel prediction competence independently of the size of a potentially gameable neural-minus-nuisance difference.

secondary: Paired nuisance-minus-joint MSE and shifted-minus-original-joint MSE with exact same fitted state and test support.
Within-family reference contrasts separately from contrasts of validation-selected families; all original/shifted adverse effects retained.

comparators.name: Nuisance-only predictor
comparators.procedure: Matched workflow/replication and whole-panel authoring ceilings; independent numerical references provide a paired methodology.

comparators.name: Ridge, 512-tree ExtraTrees and fixed random Fourier/history references
comparators.inputs: Complete nuisance history; joint appends full time-indexed log1p counts.
comparators.procedure: Use source-frozen 13-setting train/validation searches and three family refits, training-only scaling and original train+validation final fitting; no test selection.

comparators.name: Joint TEST shift +10 bins
comparators.inputs: Only final test counts rolled +10 along the 50-bin temporal axis.
comparators.procedure: Reuse exact source, selected recipe, fitted state, preprocessing and RNG; nuisance/history and all targets fixed. Do not refit or allow the investigator to see the transformed replay.

evaluation.uncertainty: Report 13 paired animal effects for every realization with nested session/lab diagnostics. Current grader retains paired values but does not implement a training/authoring uncertainty estimator or a qualified inferential decision; three authored realizations do not multiply biological n.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all cases, exactly 50 finite values per prediction, all native units and the exact 29/13/7 biological hierarchy. Malformed/missing panels, method/state mismatch or failed process closure blocks the complete score; no favorable case/arm/realization subset may replace the full selected design.
